verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any spending cap, budget limit, or usage/credit alert for Context.dev. The closest items are adjacent controls: per-minute rate-limit headers, restricted API key permissions, and no-charge behavior for failed timeouts. None of these caps or alerts on spend, so the story gets no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set a spending cap or usage alert so proxy/credit consumption doesn't silently blow past my budget
